A '''clone trooper pilot''' was present during the [[Sky Battle of Quell]] and flew a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]].

==Biography==
[[File:Unidentified_Quell_clone_pilot2.png|thumb|left|200px|The clone pilot in the co-pilot's seat of his LAAT/i at the Battle of Quell]]
After [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] was [[Sky Battle of Quell|ambushed]] by several [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class frigates]], General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] arrived above [[Quell/Legends|Quell]] in the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] to aid Secura's fleet. Three [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|gunships]] were deployed to assist and evacuate Secura's cruiser, the [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Liberty'']],<ref name="Jedi Crash">{{TCW|Jedi Crash}}</ref> one of them co-piloted<ref name="AotC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> by the clone pilot. [[B2-RP battle droid/Legends|Rocket droids]] landing on Secura's cruiser took notice of the incoming gunships, and one such droid ripped off the cockpit hatch of the pilot's gunship and began to fire. Fortunately for the pilot, he managed to escape and land back in the gunships with Ahsoka, [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and the clone troopers, but with damaged controls, the gunship crash-landed into the cruiser.<ref name="Jedi Crash" />
